verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official MCP server that gives AI assistants direct, natural-language-driven access to search docs, trigger tasks, deploy projects, and monitor runs, plus 'Skills' that teach AI coding assistants how to operate the platform — letting an AI-native user operate Trigger.dev via natural-language commands through their assistant rather than raw CLI/API calls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability in real natural-language sessions, and no evidence of a first-party chat/voice interface for direct natural-language control outside of MCP-connected assistants.
